claim.value: Supported timing showing that an identified approval occurred only after placement can establish that this approval was late.
claim.scope: The identified approval only; conditional on supported timing and does not rule out another earlier approval.

provenance.rationale: The span supplies the timing-to-lateness inference and its explicit limitation concerning possible earlier approval.

signal_basis.value: Cross-checked order and approval dates establish that the identified approval itself occurred after placement, distinguishing its occurrence from documentation creation or upload.
signal_basis.scope: The particular order and identified approval; the proposed timing finding is assumed to occur for this assessment. An upload timestamp or later account alone does not establish approval timing.

provenance.rationale: The bundle supplies cross-checking, the distinction between approval and documentation dates, the after-placement signal, and limits on timestamp and retrospective evidence. P018 identifies these as proposed findings.
The claim is supported within its bounds; no unresolved empirical bridging relation is required.

rationale: Given supported timing, approval occurring after placement is late relative to the pre-placement requirement. The claim concerns only that identified approval and makes no inference that all approval was late or absent.
uncertainty: Another earlier approval may have existed. That unresolved possibility does not undermine the lateness of the identified approval.
